title: Challenge 6 Quiz - RWA Risk, Valuation and Due Diligence

questions.question: What is market risk in an RWA project?
options: The possibility that asset values change because of market conditions
The risk of forgetting a wallet password

questions.question: Liquidity risk refers to:
options: The possibility that an investment cannot easily be bought or sold
The amount of water an asset contains
The amount of storage space required

questions.question: Why is asset valuation important before tokenization?
options: To determine a fair asset value and support accurate token pricing

questions.question: Which valuation method estimates value based on expected future income?
What is due diligence?
options: Carefully reviewing an investment before making a decision

questions.question: Which document is commonly reviewed during due diligence for a tokenized property?
Default risk refers to:
options: The possibility that a borrower or project fails to meet its financial obligations
The loss of an internet connection
The failure of a computer monitor

questions.question: Counterparty risk occurs when:
options: Another party involved in the project fails to perform its responsibilities
A blockchain network adds more validators
A smart contract is deployed successfully

questions.question: Which of the following helps reduce investment risk in an RWA project?
Before investing in an RWA project, an investor should:
options: Review the asset, legal structure, valuation and associated risks
